runtime_eligible: Membership in the unchanged bridge selectable set after all existing route and safety filters. An unconditional baseline marker is insufficient.
forced_constructor_v2: An eligible constructor actually returns version v2 and the requested family. Ineligible/unrequested cases are NOT_RUN, not measured failures.
forced_render_v2: Constructor v2 plus checked semantic parity after existing finalization and PromptCleaner. Unknown semantic parity is null and excluded from certified success counts.
semantic_parity_limit: Exact ordinary raw/cleaned equality proves preservation of existing output only. Lexical Counter checks are auxiliary; no general ownership, polarity or grammar inference is permitted.
unknown: null or NOT_AVAILABLE; never a successful binding or grammar proof
audit_only: Runner-only upstream settings are not passed into runtime diagnostics. Unimplemented audit-only producer replay is NOT_RUN, not zero unavailable cases.
blocker_unit: seed-family row; IDs are unique within a row. Counts overlap. only_blocked_by counts only singleton sets; pair/triple counts are intersections, not additive rescue estimates.
canonical_hash: SHA-256 of sorted-key UTF-8 JSON plus LF; rows/records preserve ascending run_seed order
